prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE Chinese heritage atlas fine-line illustration of the photographed Nanzhao ruler Yimouxun relief at Jianchuan Shizhongshan Grottoes: central crowned seated ruler beneath a wide carved arch, small attendants on both sides, rectangular throne and lower support; preserve the actual arrangement, no Buddha substitution. Image 1 supplies STYLE ONLY: sparse delicate black ink contours and generous white space, not its figure geometry. Image 2 supplies ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY; preserve figures' relative positions and surviving damage. landscape 1536×1024, centered, selected group entirely visible, even margins. An OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas at full opacity, black fine lines, all empty areas inside and outside figures white. Simplify minor details rather than fill with dense marks. No gray fills, shading, gradient, paper grain, color, halo added where none, cast shadow, transparent pixels, checkerboard, letters, labels, watermark, frame, tourists, fixtures or invented anatomy. A local script will remove the white background.
